text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while preparing for the Hopeful 
Stakes, Curren Chan suddenly barges into 
the Trainer's room to lodge a "protest."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What they heard was about Admire Vega 
overworking herself. Apparently, she has 
been pushing herself far too hard all on 
her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just wanting her to take a breather, even 
for a little while, the place they took 
her to was a planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then on the way home, just for a moment, 
Admire Vega opened up about her mission 
and inner feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps being able to unload even a part 
of the burden she had shouldered alone was 
enough—from then on, her tendency to 
overwork was kept in check.
